profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company, ticker META, with CIK 0001326801, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, USA. Its most recent revenue filing is a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, showing revenue of $200966000000. On its AI developer site, Meta describes building with its AI models and tools, with access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and the Meta Model API. The company says Muse Spark is tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and that it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. It also says a first working request takes under five minutes by pointing an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at the Meta Model API, and that search grounding gives a model live access to the web through a single added tool.

The product tracked for Meta is Llama (Meta), described as an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted, in the Chat and General LLMs category. A set of MCP servers is also listed in connection with Meta, most of them for Meta Ads automation, including ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, described as a Meta Ads server with 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights, co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp for Facebook and Meta Ads automation, and com.adbloop/meta-ads for bulk-creating Facebook and Instagram ads across accounts from Drive folders. Other listed servers carry Meta in their names without being Meta products, among them ai.fastmetal/fastmetal, ai.livingmeta/ai-in-research, ai.metabind/banking-assistant, ai.metabind/docs, ai.primeta/primeta, and app.metadock/metadock.

Four lawsuits involving Meta Platforms, Inc. are listed. State of New Mexico ex rel. Torrez v. Meta Platforms, Inc. is in the First Judicial District Court, Santa Fe County, New Mexico. Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. is in the District Court, W.D. Texas. Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. are both in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. California is also listed as a jurisdiction of law exposure with a count of 281.
